newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli shells hit Lebanon's Sidon port, wound 25.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shells hit Lebanon's Sidon port, wound 25.

text.p: Israel fired three rounds of shells at Lebanon's southern port city of Sidon on Monday, wounding 25 civilians, many of them seriously, security sources said.

In the second round of shelling, two shells hit crowded areas of Sidon and three slammed into the suburbs less than one hour after a shelling attack on the city 40 km (25 miles) south of the capital Beirut.
A third round of shelling followed minutes later and security sources said Israeli forces were continuing their attack.
The victims were taken to five hospitals in Sidon.
It was the first time Israel had shelled Sidon since the Jewish state mounted a major offensive in south Lebanon in April of 1996.
The shelling occurred hours after a roadside bomb killed two Lebanese civilian teenagers and seriously wounded a third just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
